steps.note: The lactase, an enzyme, is dosed in after the UHT treatment, 0.2–0.6 g per litre, through a 0.2 µm sterile filter.

steps.name: break down
steps.note: The lactose is broken down by the enzyme into glucose and galactose in the package, during storage.

processing.text: For a more neutral taste part of the lactose is first taken out by ultrafiltration; no heat step follows the lactase.
